draft.version_limit: VDMA and TÜV identify July7draft; no byte identity with an independently archived July7iteration. BDEW identifies July8. No draft difference is inferred solely from this date variation.

observations.assessment: Scope follows functional CO2 pipeline definition. No cross-border or multiple-Land condition appears. Territorial operation includes EEZ/continental shelf. Draft§1 has no express16bar threshold; corresponding use of GasHDrLtgV§1 needs legal interpretation, not automatic inheritance or denial.

KSpTG imports EnWG technical-safety/general recognised-rules provisions; DVGW compliance gives a presumption. Draftp17 expressly intends corresponding CO2 rules. A claim that no public full text was found is not evidence that no appropriate rules exist.

Inherited framework expressly permits equivalent-safety exceptions to§§3/4 and has a short-line procedure exemption under1000m. Proposals seeking clearer CO2-specific differentiation can remain reasonable; do not transform a hedged proposal into denial of these provisions.

Draft adds functional single-failure redundancy. It does not prescribe identical paired hardware in those words. Calling it1:1 redundancy may be shorthand/interpretation rather than demonstrated factual misdescription. Draft rationale itself mistakenly labels the corresponding GasHDrLtgV sentence§3(3), while operative provision is§3(4). This is a draft cross-reference issue, not an author finding.

Draft adds all unlawful interference attempts to existing accident/damage/danger reporting. No express de-minimis qualifier in added wording. Whether purposive interpretation narrows the requirement is unresolved, not disproved by general security rationale.

Draft adds prevention of impermissible low pressure for regular operation/pauses and replaces automatic gas-pipeline emergency pressure response with danger-removal/safe-state duty. Detailed engineering of safe phase envelopes is external technical evidence, not settled by draft wording.

Draft gives aggregate estimates and assumptions rather than observed infrastructure costs. Author criticisms of absent phase/dimension differentiation are model-method critiques. No cost premise promoted as observed fact merely because government model prints a number.
